## project/.kilo/plugin/aidd-telemetry-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd - do not edit by hand.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-telemetry/", import.meta.url));
const SESSION_START = [{"script":"task.cjs","args":["remind"]},{"script":"ledger.cjs","args":["ingest"]}];
const STOP = [];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [];

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function reportFollowUpFailure(script, error) {
  reportHookFailure(script, "follow-up not delivered: " + String(error));
}

function exitDescription(code, signal) {
  return "exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")");
}

// Fire and forget: a failed spawn (ENOENT, a killed timeout) or a script that never reads its
// stdin reports once and never throws past this function.
function runHook(script, args, payload, directory) {
  const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
    cwd: directory,
    stdio: ["pipe", "ignore", "ignore"],
    timeout: 5000,
  });
  let reported = false;
  const report = (error) => {
    if (reported) return;
    reported = true;
    reportHookFailure(script, error);
  };
  child.on("error", report);
  child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
    if (code !== 0 || signal !== null) report(exitDescription(code, signal));
  });
  child.stdin.on("error", report);
  child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
}

/** Runs one hook script with its payload on stdin and collects what it wrote. */
function runCapture(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdout += chunk;
    });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk;
    });
    child.on("error", (error) => resolve({ error, code: null, signal: null, stdout: "", stderr: "" }));
    child.on("close", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal, stdout, stderr }));
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  if (code !== 0) return "";
  try {
    const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
    return String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

// Awaited, unlike runHook: the script has something the model must read.
function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, signal, stdout, stderr }) => {
    if (error !== undefined) {
      reportHookFailure(script, error);
      return "";
    }
    if ((code !== 0 && code !== 2) || signal !== null) {
      reportHookFailure(script, exitDescription(code, signal));
      return "";
    }
    return answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr);
  });
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, stdout }) => {
    if (error !== undefined || code !== 0) return "";
    try {
      const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
      return output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  });
}

/** Pure: a finished tool call -> every PostToolUse hook whose matcher allows its tool. */
function postToolUseCallsFor(call, directory) {
  const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
  const args = call?.args;
  const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
  return POST_TOOL_USE.filter(
    (hook) => !hook.matcher || hook.matcher.split("|").some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === tool.toLowerCase())
  ).map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "PostToolUse",
      session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      tool_name: tool,
      tool_input: toolInput,
    },
  }));
}

const started = new Set();

function runSessionStart(event, fallbackDirectory) {
  const named = event?.properties?.sessionID;
  if (typeof named !== "string") return;
  if (event.type === "session.deleted") {
    started.delete(named);
    return;
  }
  if (started.has(named)) return;
  started.add(named);
  const directory = event.properties.info?.directory ?? fallbackDirectory;
  for (const hook of SESSION_START) {
    runHook(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: named, cwd: directory }, directory);
  }
}

const FOLLOW_UP = { aidd: "stop-follow-up" };

const AiddTelemetryKiloHooks = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const sessions = new Map();
  return {
  event: async ({ event }) => {
    try {
      const properties = event?.properties;
      const id = properties?.sessionID;
      if (typeof id !== "string") return;
      runSessionStart(event, directory);
      if (event?.type === "session.deleted") { sessions.delete(id); return; }
      if (!sessions.has(id)) {
        sessions.set(id, { idle: false, continued: false, directory: properties?.info?.directory ?? directory });
      }
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      if (event?.type === "session.status" && properties?.status?.type === "busy") {
        session.idle = false;
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle" && !session.idle) {
        session.idle = true;
        // Limit: one Stop hook per plugin; with several, the last verdict decides the continuation.
        for (const hook of STOP) {
          const payload = { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: id, cwd: session.directory, stop_hook_active: session.continued };
          const reason = await stopReasonOf(hook.script, hook.args, payload, session.directory);
          session.continued = reason !== "";
          // Not awaited: the prompt is the session's next turn, and this handler must not hold it.
          // Open limit in `kilo run`: it exits at idle before this follow-up's turn runs, on 7.7.5 and 7.8.27
          // keyed on `session.idle`, and on 7.8.27 keyed on `session.drained`.
          if (reason) {
            client.session
              .promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text: reason, metadata: FOLLOW_UP }] } })
              .catch((error) => reportFollowUpFailure(hook.script, error));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  // A user's message starts a new turn. Kilo hands every plugin every message, so a follow-up,
  // this bridge's or another plugin's, is recognised by its mark and is not one.
  "chat.message": async (input, output) => {
    const session = sessions.get(input?.sessionID);
    if (!session) return;
    if (!output?.parts?.some((part) => part?.metadata?.aidd === FOLLOW_UP.aidd)) session.continued = false;
  },
  "tool.execute.after": async (call, output) => {
    try {
      const cwd = sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory;
      for (const hook of postToolUseCallsFor(call, cwd)) {
        const answer = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, hook.payload, cwd);
        if (answer) output.output = `${output.output ?? ""}\n\n${answer}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  };
};

export default { id: "aidd-telemetry-hooks", server: AiddTelemetryKiloHooks };
